# sks3200_system (Data Source)

Switch identity and firmware.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sks3200_system" "this" {}

output "firmware" {
  value = data.sks3200_system.this.firmware
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `firmware` (String) Firmware version, e.g. 2.0.0.3.
- `hardware` (String) Hardware revision.
- `ip_address` (String) Current management IPv4 address.
- `mac_address` (String) Management MAC address.
- `model` (String) Model name, e.g. SKS3200-8E2X.
